headline.text: L3 ML4 still troubleshooting depositor and filter issues at window close — *3 open items* on new line commissioning

per_plant_summary.L1: L1 S3 was down most of the window after repeated Russell Finex pin breaks and pistachio clogging — line back at 11:19 after draining chocolate, replacing C24 belt, and adjusting to prevent nut buildup. S4 and S2 ran steadily with brief label and caustic supply interruptions cleared by mid-shift.
per_plant_summary.L2: L2 FFS ran with recurring bottom-fold and blade issues — each cleared within minutes but throughput stayed at 480 cases/hr against a 510 target at window close. ML2 added PTL recirculation valves. ML3 had frequent label breaks, all resolved quickly.
per_plant_summary.L3: L3 ML4 commissioning continued with cold stamp, water pressure, and ingredient tank issues — depositor 2 agitator and ingredient tank 2 auto mode still unresolved at 13:20. ML1 nozzle plate repaired and running. Truffle line cleared Cavanna and probe issues. MF Matrix pouch-opening problem mentioned early shift with no clear resolution.

notes.text: ML4 vibration 4 horizontal unit has been broken for approximately 2 months per operator report — now flagged for WDS open-items list.
S3 pistachio prevention measures in place: checking separating table height, verifying clusters don't climb belt, and removing detailing rod to clear nut buildup.

resolved.title: S3 enrober pin broke during production
resolved.summary: Russell Finex enrober pin failed at 21:35, stopping the line.
resolved.resolution: Caleb York replaced pin. Shift used downtime to complete caustic wash due to high cook times (42-47 min).

resolved.title: S3 Russell Finex repeatedly clogged with pistachios
resolved.summary: Filter clogged four times between 01:54 and 04:51, pressure spiking and preventing temper.
resolved.resolution: Team drained all chocolate from enrober, flushed crystallizer, added fresh chocolate, and replaced another broken pin. Line running again at 06:22.

resolved.title: S2 labels not staged for FD product changeover
resolved.summary: First shift discovered FD labels were at Springville warehouse, not in L1.
resolved.resolution: Jody retrieved labels from Springville and delivered to warehouse at 07:05; Troy completed setup by 07:22.

resolved.title: S3 C24 belt shifted and frayed significantly
resolved.summary: Belt shifted during first shift, rubbing against machine and creating fibers found in Matrix 3.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance replaced belt. ATP passed with result of 0 at 11:06. QA inspected area and pallet bags for fibers.

resolved.title: S4 caustic shortage delayed kitchen wash
resolved.summary: Only one caustic wash cycle completed when warehouse reported no caustic in L1 or building 2.
resolved.resolution: Marcos found 2 buckets of caustic and completed second wash cycle by 08:32.

resolved.title: S2 label printer cutting letters and code illegible
resolved.summary: Label printer output had cut letters and poor code legibility after setup.
resolved.resolution: Troy resolved ribbon issue by 08:34. 4.5 pallets of unlabeled jars accumulated during troubleshooting.

resolved.title: S4 tunnel 2 contaminated with fibers
resolved.summary: QA and operations found fibers in tunnel 2 requiring cleaning before start-up.
resolved.resolution: Source identified as clogged filters. Chris J cleaned with compressed air; area cleaned and passed inspection by 10:04.

resolved.title: S2 label machine sensor not detecting gap
resolved.summary: Sensor controlling label feed stopped sensing the gap between labels.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 13:07 — Lolo looked up training instructions and got sensor working again (Troy Baxter).

resolved.title: FFS pouches coming out with bottom fold
resolved.summary: Pouches had bottom fold defect, occurring three separate times during the window.
resolved.resolution: Each occurrence cleared by maintenance adjustments within 3-17 minutes. Last cleared at 08:47 after blade tightened.

resolved.title: ML3 label breaks recurring throughout shifts
resolved.summary: Line went down for broken labels at 14:10, 15:53, 16:45, 20:09, and 21:42.
resolved.resolution: Each incident cleared within 1-3 minutes. Team cleaned line, tightened roller, and measured rolls.

resolved.title: ML4 cold stamp too tight on commissioning test
resolved.summary: First 20-mold test failed because cold stamp clearance was too tight, molds sticking.
resolved.resolution: Marcel heated stamp, disconnected, adjusted mold guide distance, reconnected, cooled. 100 molds deposited successfully by 16:19.

resolved.title: ML4 ingredient tank 2 pump leaking
resolved.summary: Pump on ingredient tank 2 developed leak during commissioning, team manually filled depositor 3 with buckets.
resolved.resolution: Gasket on ingredient tank 2 dep 3 replaced by 20:50.

resolved.title: Truffle line Cavanna vacuum areas clogged
resolved.summary: Vacuum areas on Cavannas clogged during CILT, causing machine to operate improperly and 10 bins to accumulate.
resolved.resolution: Cleaned; cute Cavanna also running. Grey reminded operators to clean vacuum areas during CILT going forward.

resolved.title: ML4 water pressure faults on depositors
resolved.summary: Depositor tempering devices not reaching temp, water pressure faults on multiple units.
resolved.resolution: Maintenance found water hoses crossed and screens clogged with hard water. Cleaned screens and corrected hoses; faults cleared by 10:46.

resolved.title: ML1 nozzle plate damaged threads
resolved.summary: Nozzle plate had 2 damaged threads requiring repair before line could start.
resolved.resolution: Nathan repaired threads, reassembled, and passed ATP by 10:01. Line started depositing at 11:18.

resolved.title: Truffle line tempermeter not working
resolved.summary: Newly replaced tempermeter failed, causing volatile temper readings.
resolved.resolution: Nathan replaced temperature probe at 13:06 with last unit in inventory — "This is the last one in total inventory until more arrive."

resolved.title: ML1 Cavanna printer intermittent on some bars
resolved.summary: Cavanna printer printed on some bars but not others.
resolved.resolution: Cleared by 12:41 — "Cavanna's printer is working correctly."

resolved.title: Truffle line Cavanna cutter sensor incorrect
resolved.summary: Cute Cavanna cutter had wrong sensor installed.
resolved.resolution: Nathan Ruiz installed proper sensor at 11:57.

needs_attention.title: FFS throughput below target at window close
needs_attention.summary: Line achieving 480 cases/hr vs 510 target despite multiple speed increases and machine fixes.
needs_attention.status: Speed bumped from 80 to 82 to 85. Jeffrey Barney to post hourly counts. Last reported 480 cases 11:30-12:30.

needs_attention.title: ML4 tempergraph communication error unresolved
needs_attention.summary: Tempergraph on AD1 broken with communication error; Jakob unable to fix remotely with programmer.
needs_attention.status: Jakob coming back at 17:00 to attempt fix again. Team using tempermeter in interim. DO NOT TOUCH TEMPERGRAPH PAGE per Jakob at 11:51.

needs_attention.title: ML4 vibration 4 horizontal unit broken for 2 months
needs_attention.summary: Horizontal vibration on depositor not working; operators report it's been damaged approximately 2 months.
needs_attention.status: Marcel identified during commissioning. Added to WDS open-items list for vendor visit. Rod end also broken and repaired at 07:49.

needs_attention.title: MF Matrix pouch opening and pick-up issues
needs_attention.summary: Matrix experiencing problems with pouch opening, dumping chocolate outside pouches, and pick-up failures.
needs_attention.status: Issues reported at start of first shift (07:56). Maintenance called; line stopped multiple times overnight. No clear resolution by window close at 13:20.

needs_attention.title: ML4 depositor 2 agitator not moving properly
needs_attention.summary: One of the agitators on depositor 2 not moving like the other, maintenance called.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance called at 12:23, no resolution posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: ML4 ingredient tank 2 not sending product in auto
needs_attention.summary: Ingredient tank 2 only working in manual mode, not auto. Separate from earlier pump leak.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance looking at issue as of 12:44. Operators manually filling tank after running out of cream at 13:21.

needs_attention.title: ML1 chocolate loading tearing film at infeed
needs_attention.summary: Chocolate loading into flow wrapper tearing film; maintenance adjusting infeed belts and sensor B150.
needs_attention.status: Maintenance adjusting infeed belts and sensor B150 as of 13:15. No resolution posted by window close.
